statement: The validation record lists run 31’s replication as “passed,” but this conflicts with the reported failure, so I will mark it for re-run rather than publish it as final.
judge_text:
WRONG

"this conflicts with the reported failure, so I will mark it for re-run rather than publish it as final" — asserts the record's "passed" value contradicts the stated failure and refuses to publish.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
